channel.title: INSTAR Lab News
channel.description: Research briefs, methods, and evidence from INSTAR Lab’s work in AI, quantum science, computing, health, energy, space, and the sciences.

item.title: What a Brain Scan Study Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on what functional MRI measures, why testing a whole brain at once can produce false positives, what happened when 70 teams analysed the same scans, and how many people a study of differences between brains needs.

item.title: What a Coral Heat-Stress Map Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how NOAA's satellite coral-bleaching heat-stress products are built, what a Degree Heating Week measures, why a heat-stress alert is not a report of bleaching, and what field surveys have added.

item.title: What an Exoplanet Detection Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on what the transit and radial-velocity methods measure, why a planet candidate is not yet a planet, what the habitable zone does and does not mean, and how the claim of a possible biosignature gas on K2-18 b has held up under independent reanalysis.

item.title: What a Polygenic Score Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how a polygenic risk score is built, why it describes relative rather than absolute risk, what a 2018 study found at the top of the score range, why today's scores work better for some ancestries than others, and what reporting standards ask for.

item.title: What a Single Psychology Study Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on what large replication projects in psychology and the social sciences found, why a failed replication is not a verdict, what a p-value does not measure, and what preregistration changes.

item.title: What a Radiocarbon Date Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on what a radiocarbon lab measures, why a radiocarbon age must be calibrated before it becomes a calendar date, why the answer is a range rather than a year, and how old wood, reservoir effects and contamination can separate a date from the event it is meant to date.

item.title: What an AI Benchmark Score Does and Does Not Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how language-model benchmarks work, where their scores can mislead, and the questions to ask before trusting one.

item.title: What a Wearable Heart-Rate Reading Can and Cannot Tell You
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how wrist wearables estimate heart rate, how close their readings come to an ECG, where they drift, and what a heart-rhythm alert means.

item.title: Open data is part of the research infrastructure
item.description: Why transparent datasets, reproducible methods, and clear limits matter to credible nonprofit research.

item.title: Legal Foundations for Emerging Technology Governance
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how legal and regulatory systems govern fast-moving technologies such as AI, biotechnology, and quantum computing.

item.title: Materials Science and the Energy Transition
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on the materials science behind energy storage and generation, and why atomic-scale discovery to a durable system is the hard part.

item.title: Formal Methods and Trust in Safety-Critical Software
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on formal verification for safety-critical and high-assurance software—and why testing alone cannot establish correctness.

item.title: Precision Agriculture and Open Agricultural Data
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on sensor networks, remote sensing, and soil microbiome research in precision agriculture, and why open datasets matter.

item.title: Clinical AI Safety Research
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on how AI can improve patient safety and clinical workflows, and why safety evaluation and human oversight come before deployment.

item.title: HPC Infrastructure for AI
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research brief on GPU-accelerated computing, sovereign on-premises AI infrastructure, and the applied systems work behind frontier capability.

item.title: Quantum Sensing Breakthroughs
item.description: An INSTAR Lab research perspective on advances in qubit coherence, quantum error correction, and the path toward practical quantum sensing and computation.
